name: Leaving Soon
description: Surfaces scheduled-deletion media as symlink-backed leaving-soon libraries in Jellyfin. Polls provider apps (Maintainerr, OxiCleanarr) for scheduled-deletion media.
overview: Polls provider apps for scheduled-deletion media and manages symlink libraries, virtual folders, and refreshes itself.

versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 - Initial release
- Provider-pull architecture: polls Maintainerr and OxiCleanarr leaving-soon endpoints
- Normalized leaving-soon contract (mediaServerId, type, deletionDate)
- Resolves on-disk paths from Jellyfin's own metadata
- Manages symlinks, virtual folders, and library refreshes in-process
- hide-when-empty with Jellyfin double-refresh for user views
